meanings.hidden_knowledge: The term 'passing score' refers to the metric measuring the player's ability to execute short-range passes to nearby teammates.

    pa.preferred_foot,
    AVG(pa.short_passing) AS avg_passing_score
FROM 
    Player_Attributes pa
JOIN 
    Player p ON pa.player_api_id = p.player_api_id
WHERE 
    p.height > 180
GROUP BY 
    pa.preferred_foot

question.nlq: Hey there! Could you help me figure out which teams were super aggressive defensively during 2015? Like, I wanna see those teams with high defensive numbers... but wait, I'm kinda confused 'cause sometimes people mean different things when they say 'defensive stats'. Could you show me the details so I know what we're talking about?

meanings.hidden_knowledge: When I say 'defensive stats' or 'aggressive defensively', I'm specifically referring to the defencePressure column, which measures how high up the pitch a team starts pressuring the opponent - higher scores mean more aggressive pressing.
meanings.gt_sql:
SELECT T.team_long_name, TA.defencePressure
FROM Team_Attributes TA
INNER JOIN Team T ON TA.team_api_id = T.team_api_id
WHERE TA.date LIKE '2015%'
ORDER BY TA.defencePressure DESC

meanings.hidden_knowledge: When I say 'defensive stats' or 'aggressive defensively', I'm specifically referring to the defenceAggression column, which affects how the team approaches tackling the ball possessor - higher scores mean more aggressive tackling and confrontation.

    T.team_long_name,

FROM 
    Team_Attributes TA
JOIN

WHERE 
    TA.date LIKE '%2015%'
